newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, wide bid/offer spreads in '98.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, wide bid/offer spreads in '98.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were not traded on Wednesday morning. Front month August was bid at 9.15 pence a therm against an offer at 9.35 pence, after settling on Tuesday night at 9.225 pence a therm.

But the range was wider in the second month, September, with the bid/offer spread at 9.00/9.50 pence a therm. And from the beginning of next year the bid/offer spread widened to nearly a penny a therm in some months. Bids and offers were posted for the first nine of the 12 contract months.
The IPE announced on Tuesday evening a series of changes to the contract which will be implemented on August 8 and are designed to improve liquidity.

These include the introduction of trading of the Balance of the Month on the screen-based Energy Trading System, new trading hours from 10.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m. (0900-1600 GMT) without a break, and an increase in the minimum tick size from 0.005 pence to 0.01 pence a therm.
